summary.name: FineCam
summary.one_liner: FineCam (originally named VibeCam) is an AI virtual camera app that turns a smartphone or other cameras into a webcam source for video calls, recordings and live streams.
use_cases: Turning an iPhone or iPad into a webcam for video calls
Recording tutorials, demos or presentations of software
Removing or replacing background during video calls
Online teaching with slides and webpages
summary.what_it_does: FineCam connects a smartphone, digital or DSLR camera, action camera, or webcam to a computer as a virtual camera with wireless connectivity, multiple angles, and adjustable zoom, resolution, orientation, and overlay settings. It uses AI-based background removal and a bokeh effect, and offers virtual backgrounds, filters, and brightness and contrast controls. Users can capture from application windows, webpages, YouTube, slides, and iPhone or iPad screens, and place webcam footage anywhere on screen. Recording features include segment recording that can be resumed and remixed, and simultaneous multi-camera capture. The page describes GPU hardware acceleration for video processing and deep-learning-based background removal.
notable: Turns a phone into a wireless HD webcam with no limit on number of connected cameras
AI background removal and generated backgrounds
Segment recording that can be paused, resumed and remixed
Captures individual app windows, webpages, YouTube and iPhone/iPad screens
caveats: Page text does not state pricing; the directory listing marks it as #paid
Page mentions a free-for-iPhone-webcam claim only in a quoted testimonial, not as a stated plan
Requires a smartphone or other camera for multi-camera use
